annotations.title: Build an X ads line item (paused)

description: Create a line item — X's ad group — under a campaign. ALWAYS CREATED PAUSED with no override. THE TREE ON X IS campaign -> line item -> promoted post, and a campaign ALONE CANNOT SERVE: this is the middle level, and it still cannot serve until you attach a post with create_x_ads_promoted_tweet. Targeting attaches HERE (add_x_ads_targeting), never to the campaign. `objective` is validated before dispatch because X answers an invalid one with a 500 that reads like an outage; note that WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS and SITE_VISITS are `goal` values and are NOT objectives. `bidStrategy` MAX/TARGET require a bidAmount; AUTO lets X set it. Omitting startTime records now, and the read-back says so. Everything is READ BACK from X before you are told it exists; print the returned note verbatim.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

bidAmount.description: required for MAX/TARGET; in the ad account's currency

bidStrategy.description: AUTO lets X set the bid; MAX and TARGET need bidAmount

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end time for this line item

goal.description: optimization goal, e.g. LINK_CLICKS or WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS; these are goals, not objectives

objective.description: one per campaign (X refuses a second objective). For an X LEAD AD use WEBSITE_CLICKS with a lead-form card — X retired LEAD_GENERATION

productType.description: default PROMOTED_TWEETS — PROMOTED_ACCOUNT when objective is FOLLOWERS, and that line item serves the ACCOUNT attached with create_x_ads_promoted_account

standardDelivery.description: false = accelerated, only with line item budgets; X refuses it under a campaign budget

totalBudget.description: lifetime budget for this line item in ad account currency
